description: Configuration governing per-run summary delivery to Salesforce.

enabled.description: Master opt-in flag; disabled by default to prevent unintended writes
enabled.title: Enabled

salesforce_org_id.description: Expected 15 or 18 character Salesforce Organization ID
salesforce_org_id.title: Salesforce Org Id

test_recipient.description: Explicit test recipient identifier/email required for live notification checks
test_recipient.title: Test Recipient

max_dispatch_attempts.description: Maximum lifetime dispatch attempts before transitioning to EXHAUSTED
max_dispatch_attempts.title: Max Dispatch Attempts

max_reconcile_attempts.description: Maximum lifetime reconciliation attempts before transitioning to EXHAUSTED
max_reconcile_attempts.title: Max Reconcile Attempts

max_recovery_age_hours.description: Maximum age in hours during which unfinalized deliveries will be retried
max_recovery_age_hours.title: Max Recovery Age Hours

initial_backoff_seconds.description: Initial exponential backoff delay in seconds
initial_backoff_seconds.title: Initial Backoff Seconds

max_backoff_seconds.description: Ceiling for exponential backoff delay in seconds
max_backoff_seconds.title: Max Backoff Seconds

jitter_ratio.description: Randomized jitter fraction applied to backoff delays
jitter_ratio.title: Jitter Ratio

max_records_per_drain.description: Maximum number of due deliveries processed in a single drain invocation
max_records_per_drain.title: Max Records Per Drain

activation_epoch_utc.description: Earliest run completion timestamp eligible for delivery (prevents backfill flooding)
activation_epoch_utc.title: Activation Epoch Utc

target_external_id_field.description: External ID field on the target sObject
target_external_id_field.title: Target External Id Field

title: SummaryDeliverySettings
